facts.business: Praj Industries Limited is engaged in the business of process and project engineering, providing technology solutions for biofuels, breweries, wastewater treatment, and high-purity systems.

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement in estimating total costs to complete, assessing project progress, and determining timing of revenue and profit recognition, including contingencies for project risks and liquidated damages.
Expected losses on onerous contracts require significant judgement when such losses become probable based on expected total contract cost.
facts.related_party_note: CSR expenditure of Rs 62.460 million incurred through related party - Praj Foundation (trust controlled by the company).
